summary: Session-setup screen parameter initializer: stores the current RaceMode (dword_7D0410) into this at offset 0x324 and a pointer to the UI index global (dword_7CEAA4) into this at offset 0x320, formats the indexed UI list item text into a local buffer via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, pushes it into the edit buffer via EditBufferStringUpdate, and finally resolves an object of type 19 through the dispatch interface at dword_7CD8C0 and compares its name against this when it exists. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Store the RaceMode value dword_7D0410 into this at offset 0x324 (dword index 201).
Store the address of the UI index global dword_7CEAA4 into this at offset 0x320 (dword index 200).
Fetch the UI list item indexed by dword_7CEAA4 via UIListIndexedAccessor.
Format the fetched item into the local buffer v5 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Push the formatted text into the edit buffer via EditBufferStringUpdate.
Resolve an object of type 19 through the dispatch interface at dword_7CD8C0 (vtable slot 28).
When the resolved object is non-null, compare its name against this via ObjectNameComparison.

unresolved: Semantics of the object resolved by the dispatch interface (type 19) and why its name is compared against this.
Whether the this fields at offsets 0x320/0x324 are consumed elsewhere after this setup step.
